info.title: Authorized Partner API Specification

requests.description: The API can use to push or delete a single URI into Digital Locker using DigiLocker Id acquired using Get User Details API. This API can be used to push the certificate details to Digital Locker as and when a certificate is generated in the issuer system. The issuing departments must register on DigiLocker as a registered Issuer and implement the requisite Issuer APIs as mentioned in Digital Locker Issuer API Specification document prior to pushing certificates using this API.
requests.name: Push URI to Account

requests.description: This API can be used to verify whether a mobile number or Aadhaar number is already registered with DigiLocker.
requests.name: Verify Account

requests.description: Call to this API starts authorization flow using OAuth 2.0 protocol. This isn't an API call—it's a DigiLocker web page that lets the user sign in to DigiLocker and authorize your application to access user’s data. After the user decides whether or not to authorize your app, they will be redirected to the redirect link provided by your application.
requests.name: Get Authorization Code

requests.description: The client device calls the DigiLocker API to get the device code by providing the client_id issued to the device OEM and either the username or the mobile number of the user. DigiLocker responds with a device code and then sends an OTP on the mobile number and email address associated with the user’s account. The masked mobile number and email address is also sent in response. The device should use these values to notify the users about the mobile and email address on which the OTP has been sent.
requests.name: Get Device Code

requests.description: This API can be used to save/upload a file to uploaded documents in DigiLocker. The allowed file types are JPG, JPEG, PNG and PDF. The file size must not exceed 10MB.
requests.name: Upload file to locker
requests.note: Replace {{AUTHORIZED_PARTNER_API_SPECIFICATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads

requests.description: Returns a file from URI. This API can be used to fetch both issued document and uploaded document.
requests.name: Get File from URI
requests.note: Replace {{AUTHORIZED_PARTNER_API_SPECIFICATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Client applications can revoke a previously obtained refresh or access token when it is no longer needed. This is done by making a request to the token revocation endpoint. DigiLocker will invalidate the specified token and, if applicable, other tokens based on the same authorisation grant. This API may be used to sign out a user from DigiLocker. This API will work for server based web applications, mobile application and limited input devices.
requests.name: Revoke Token.

requests.description: This endpoint only applies to apps using the authorization code flow. An app calls this endpoint to acquire a bearer token once the user has authorized the app. Calls to /oauth2/1/token need to be authenticated using the app's key and secret. These can either be passed as application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST parameters (see parameters below) or via HTTP basic authentication. If basic authentication is used, the app key should be provided as the username, and the app secret should be provided as the password.
requests.name: Get Access Token

requests.description: Client applications can call this API to get the DigiLocker Id, name, date of birth and gender of the account holder. An access token is required to call this API. The API will return the user details of the account with which the access token is linked. It is strongly recommended that the API can be called by client application only once after acquiring the access token. Since the user details do not change, the client application may store the values and use them when necessary than calling this API repeatedly.
requests.name: Get User Details

requests.description: Returns the certificate data in machine readable XML format for a URI. This API can be used to only for issued documents. The XML data may not be available for all documents. If the XML data is available for a particular document, the mime parameter in Get List of Issued Documents API will contain application/xml. Please refer to Digital Locker XML Certificate Formats for more details of XML formats of various documents.
requests.name: Get Certificate Data in XML Format from URI
requests.note: Replace {{AUTHORIZED_PARTNER_API_SPECIFICATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get Certificate Data in XML Format from URI
